set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §2.8, §3 S4c.

The general source (any validated model) exposes evidenceOf and primaryOf; the text source keeps sourceSupport.

Scope:
story and align call sites.

Acceptance criteria:
1. AlignmentSource is sealed.
2. The general source built from any StoryModel[Validated] exposes evidenceOf and primaryOf; the text source built from TextModel[Validated] keeps sourceSupport and is what StorySourceView consumes.
3. Three align call sites change mechanically; scoring is unchanged.
4. The S0 pins are unchanged, including the HSMM golden.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: D1A-types S4c: seal and split AlignmentSource
